description: React component for user profile picture settings, including upload, remove, and default image handling.

classes.name: SettingPicture
classes.description: React component class for managing user profile picture settings, including file upload, removal, and default image selection.

methods.name: focusFirstElement
methods.description: Focuses the first element in the setting list.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Sets focus on first element and adds event listener for file input.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Updates picture if a new file prop is received.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Releases object URL and removes event listener.

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Resets remove and default flags, calls updateSection callback.

methods.name: handleFileSelected
methods.description: Focuses the confirm button when a file is selected.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Handles save action, calling appropriate callback based on state.

methods.name: handleRemoveSrc
methods.description: Sets state to remove source and refocuses.

methods.name: handleSetDefaultSrc
methods.description: Sets state to default source and refocuses.

methods.name: handleFileChange
methods.description: Resets flags and triggers onFileChange callback.

methods.name: setPicture
methods.description: Creates object URL for file, reads EXIF orientation, and updates state.

methods.name: renderImg
methods.description: Renders the image preview or default image with optional remove/edit controls.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the entire component UI including image, buttons, and error messages.
